job.title: Chief Financial Officer
job.description:
PARTNER Executive is proud to be supporting Perth Children's Hospital Foundation in the search for its new Chief Financial Officer and Company Secretary.

Perth Children's Hospital Foundation is a specialist children’s healthcare charity with a single beneficiary, Perth Children's Hospital and, after government, the largest funder of the hospital and the wider Child and Adolescent Health Service. Backed by a loyal donor base, major philanthropic partners and a strong events and corporate partnership program, the Foundation is one of the largest philanthropic organisations in WA, and its funding continues to grow year on year as it takes on landmark projects advancing children’s healthcare.

This is a landmark period for the Foundation. Sandcastles (Boodja Mia) in Swanbourne, Western Australia's first purpose-built children's hospice, is about to welcome its first families. Delivered by the Foundation in partnership with the Child and Adolescent Health Service, the $38.6 million hospice will provide around the clock specialist care, respite, end of life care and bereavement support for children with life limiting conditions and their families from across the state. Alongside Sandcastles, the Foundation continues to back major initiatives in childhood disease including cancer, rare and undiagnosed disease, rehabilitation and recovery and respiratory research, funding the latest equipment and technology, education and training initiatives and supporting positive patient experiences with a range of partners. The Foundation is now seeking a Chief Financial Officer and Company Secretary to lead its corporate services function and partner with the CEO and Board through its next phase of growth.

The role

Reporting to the CEO, you will lead the Foundation's corporate services function, spanning Finance, HR, and Risk and Compliance, and serve as Company Secretary for all group entities. You will provide strategic financial leadership and commercial advice to the CEO and Board, drive business transformation, and make sure every dollar raised is managed with the transparency donors and partners expect.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Ultimate accountability for financial strategy, sustainability, risk and compliance
  • Company Secretary for all group entities, working closely with the Board and CEO on governance best practice
  • Leading Finance, HR, and Risk and Compliance through a team of senior managers
  • Driving process improvement and business transformation across the organisation
  • Providing strategic HR direction across workforce planning, talent and engagement

About you

You will be a CA or CPA qualified executive with senior leadership experience across finance and corporate services, together with Company Secretary or Board governance experience. You'll have a track record of leading business transformation and bring a strong understanding of governance and regulatory frameworks in the not-for-profit sector. Experience in a charity, foundation or health organisation will be highly regarded.

You'll be a value led leader who is comfortable with tough decisions, and able to engage with empathy and discretion in a sensitive environment that includes patients' families and donors.

Above all, you'll want your work to make a real difference to the lives of children and families across Western Australia.

job.title: Contracts Manager
job.description:
An ASX listed gold developer is moving one of Western Australia's most significant new gold projects toward construction, and is building the team that will deliver it. This is a chance to join early, shape the contracting framework from the ground up and see a major project through from feasibility to first gold.

The role

You will lead the contracting activity across the project's development phase. That means owning the full contract lifecycle on a portfolio of significant packages, from strategy and tender through to award, administration and close out. You will be the commercial anchor between the project team, suppliers and contractors, protecting the company's position while keeping relationships constructive.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Developing contracting and procurement strategies for major packages including EPC/EPCM, mining services, earthworks, accommodation and site services
  • Running tender processes, evaluations and negotiations, and preparing award recommendations
  • Drafting and managing contracts, variations, claims and commercial correspondence
  • Building the systems, templates and governance that will support the business into construction and operations
  • Working closely with project, finance, legal and operations teams to manage commercial risk

About you

  • Strong contracts background in mining, resources or major infrastructure, ideally with exposure to a project moving through FID and construction
  • Hands on experience with large contract packages and standard forms (AS4000, AS2124 or similar)
  • Commercially sharp negotiator who is comfortable holding a position with tier one contractors
  • Able to build process in a growing business rather than inheriting it
  • Tertiary qualifications in law, engineering, commerce or a related discipline

What's on offer

A competitive salary package, a Perth based role with site visits as required, and the opportunity to be part of the core team delivering a new gold mine in WA at a pivotal stage.

job.title: Senior Project Manager
job.description:
A rare opportunity to lead complex remote construction projects from end to end.

We've been engaged to find a genuine senior construction leader to take full ownership of a major remote project valued at $80M+. This is not a coordinator-style role, it's a project leadership appointment for someone with the instincts, presence and commercial sharpness to drive a sophisticated, multi-front project with confidence.

The project

This is a genuinely demanding environment, multiple concurrent work fronts, staged construction, significant refurbishment works within an operating facility, live operational interfaces, and sophisticated client and consultant stakeholders. It also carries a large volume of externally developed architectural and engineering documentation that demands disciplined management and execution.

In short, sequencing, planning, interfaces and responsiveness are everything. The successful candidate will effectively live in the programme.

The role

Reporting into senior leadership and fully dedicated to this single project, you'll take complete ownership of delivery, safety, quality, schedule, cost and team morale. You'll be Perth-based with regular multi-day site visits each fortnight.

You'll be exceptionally strong across:

  • Programme development, sequencing and schedule management
  • Driving construction delivery in line with programme
  • Managing multiple work fronts simultaneously
  • Client and stakeholder management at a sophisticated level
  • Commercial control and awareness
  • Structured reporting and clear communication
  • Subcontractor management
  • Leading multidisciplinary project teams

A properly resourced leadership role

This is a well-supported appointment. You'll lead a full dedicated project team including Project Engineers, Project Controllers, Schedulers, QA and HSE personnel, Supervisors, multiple Site Managers, Contract Administration support and a newly appointed Commercial Manager. The structure is there, we need the leader to drive it.

About you

  • 10+ years' construction industry experience
  • Strong commercial acumen and excellent leadership capability
  • Proven track record delivering large, complex, highly coordinated projects with multiple stakeholders and operational constraints
  • Strong client-facing skills and the composure to operate calmly and decisively under pressure
  • Tertiary qualifications in Construction, Engineering, Project Management or similar

Ideal backgrounds include remote/mining infrastructure, accommodation villages, industrial, defence, or sophisticated commercial construction. We're open to candidates beyond mining, what matters is that you've delivered complex, coordinated projects successfully.

Personality is key. We're looking for someone well planned and considered, confident without arrogance, a natural leader who delegates effectively and creates confidence with both clients and internal teams. The real deal.

job.title: Group Contracts & Commercial Manager
job.description:
An ASX listed gold developer is advancing one of Western Australia's most significant new gold projects toward a final investment decision and construction. With funding and delivery firmly in focus, the business is appointing a senior commercial leader to set the contracting and commercial direction for the group as it transitions from developer to producer.

The role

This is a senior, group level role with broad commercial accountability. You will lead the contracts and commercial function across the business, setting strategy, building the team and taking ownership of the agreements that will underpin construction and future operations. You will work closely with the executive team and board on key commercial decisions, and be a trusted voice on risk, value and deal structure.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Setting the group's contracting and procurement strategy for the development and operating phases
  • Leading the negotiation of major agreements including EPC/EPCM, mining services, power, accommodation, logistics and key supply contracts
  • Supporting project financing with commercial input, contract due diligence and lender requirements
  • Building and leading a capable contracts and commercial team, along with the systems, policies and governance to support it
  • Providing commercial advice to the executive and board on major decisions, risk allocation and value
  • Managing key contractor and supplier relationships at a senior level

About you

  • Senior contracts or commercial leadership experience in mining, resources or major infrastructure
  • Proven track record negotiating major contracts on a project moving through FID, construction and into production
  • Exposure to project finance processes and the commercial demands of lenders
  • Strong judgement and presence, comfortable influencing at executive and board level
  • Experience building teams and commercial frameworks in a growing business
  • Tertiary qualifications in law, engineering, commerce or a related discipline

job.title: GM Project Development & Strategy
job.description:
PARTNER Executive is conducting a confidential search for a Perth based engineering, manufacturing and site services specialist, part of a global infrastructure group, appointing a General Manager, Business Development & Strategy. The business is a recognised specialist in operational technology, control systems, electrical engineering and power systems integration, and it self performs the full OT and electrical scope of a project. That vertical integration is the moat. This role is about scaling it.

The mandate is to step up and win packages directly as principal contractor across WA's mining, utility, IPP and industrial capex pipeline, typically in the $10M to $50M range. Switchroom replacements, primary plant upgrades, substation augmentations, BESS balance of plant, microgrid and SAPS rollouts. This is a hunting role first and a strategy role second. You will personally originate and close, and lead the bids that win.

The Opportunity:

  • Personally hunt, qualify and close principal contract opportunities with miners, utilities, IPPs and industrial asset owners
  • Own capture and bid strategy on high value pursuits: bid or no bid gates, competitor analysis, win themes, price to win and risk allocation
  • Convert an established, current WA network into qualified and winnable pipeline, then lead cross functional bid teams to submission
  • An electrical contracting, specialist power or power and energy background is essential, not adjacent industry experience
  • Minimum 15 years across electrical contracting, power systems, switchroom manufacturing, OT or SCADA or electrical EPC delivery, with at least 10 years in BD, capture, presales or bid leadership
  • Demonstrable principal contract capture at $5M plus package scale, where you led the bid strategy and closure yourself, alongside divisional P&L or pipeline target ownership

job.title: GM Power Solutions
job.description:
PARTNER Executive has been retained to find the founding General Manager of a new Power Solutions division within a Perth-based engineering, manufacturing and site services business. The mandate: enter the WA energy storage market, substations, BESS and stand-alone power systems, with board-level backing, approved budget and a clearly defined strategy. This is a genuine greenfield build, and a career-defining opportunity for the right leader.

The Opportunity:

  • Founding leader of a new division: own the P&L from inception, build the team, establish the market presence and deliver the first projects.
  • Ride the WA energy transition: a rapidly growing storage market backed by billions in state renewable commitments and active utility procurement programs.
  • Leverage a vertically integrated platform, engineering, manufacturing and site services, to deliver turnkey solutions, with sister companies in the group for joint bidding on larger opportunities.
  • Your background: 10+ years in power, energy or renewables in Australia, with senior leadership experience and delivery across substation, HV, BESS, SAPS, microgrid or similar distributed energy projects.
  • An established WA energy sector network is essential, utilities, Tier 1 miners or IPPs.
  • Suited to an entrepreneurial, hands-on builder: someone willing to write the first bid, visit the first site and commission the first unit, then scale the team around them.

job.title: Mine Manager
job.description:
PARTNER Executive has been engaged to conduct a search for a Mining Manager with a leading mining company. This is a residential leadership role based in regional WA, a senior operational seat offering the scale, systems and career pathways that only a global major can provide.

To be clear on what we're looking for: this is a role for a proven Mining Manager, not a step up. You will have held the seat before, at scale, and have the operational depth and leadership maturity that comes with running large, complex mining operations.

The Opportunity:

  • A senior residential leadership role in regional WA, build your career and your lifestyle in the same place.
  • Accountability for safe, efficient mining operations at a large-scale site.
  • Lead, coach and develop large multidisciplinary teams, with a strong focus on safety culture and operational discipline.
  • Your background: demonstrated experience as a Mining Manager on large mine sites, this is not a development opportunity for an aspiring leader.
  • Relevant WA statutory certification highly regarded.
  • A confidential process, all enquiries handled with complete discretion.

job.title: Chief Financial Officer
job.description:
PARTNER Executive is delighted to be partnering with a successful, privately owned property investment and management group on the appointment of its first Chief Financial Officer. With an established portfolio anchored in shopping centres and retail assets, the business is entering an exciting new chapter, and this appointment will play a central role in shaping its future direction.

As the inaugural CFO, you will work closely with the owners and leadership team, providing financial and commercial leadership across the portfolio and building the finance function to support the group's continued growth. This is a genuinely strategic role, well beyond the numbers.

The Opportunity:

  • A first-of-its-kind appointment: the business's inaugural CFO, with real scope to build and shape the finance function from the ground up.
  • Strategic influence: partner directly with the owners on investment decisions, portfolio strategy and growth planning.
  • Broad commercial remit across an established portfolio of shopping centres and retail property assets.
  • Drive financial leadership: reporting, capital management, funding and performance across the group.
  • A strong property background is essential, with shopping centre / retail asset experience highly regarded.
  • Suited to a commercially astute, hands-on finance leader who wants genuine ownership of their function and a seat at the table.

job.title: Business Development Manager Queensland
job.description:

As the exclusive regional partner of one of the world's largest petrochemical companies, our client has built a strong national reputation as a premium supplier to B2B customers, with service and support at the centre of its offer.

This role is all about growth: identifying new customers, winning tenders and building lasting relationships across Queensland. Critically, we're looking for someone with a genuine, established network across the mining and resources sector, the relationships and credibility to open doors from day one.

The Opportunity:

  • Own new business development across QLD for a fast-growing national supplier with a premium product offering.
  • A strong mining and resources network is essential: this role will live and breathe the sector, and your existing relationships will be key to success.
  • Full sales cycle ownership: prospecting, proposals, tenders and pricing through to conversion and account growth.
  • Genuine autonomy: operate independently with the backing of a national sales team and leadership that trusts you to run your patch.
  • Brisbane-based with travel as required.
  • Suited to an experienced, proficient negotiator who is self-driven, commercially sharp and thrives on hunting new business.

Opportunities to live and lead in the Pilbara at this level don't come up often. This one will suit a civil construction operator who's ready to take the step up and make the role their own.

  • Residential position based in Tom Price, a rare opportunity to build a senior career in the Pilbara without the FIFO lifestyle.
  • Drive day-to-day delivery across civil and mining works for major clients in one of Australia's most active resources regions.
  • A senior seat in a well-established contracting business with a strong regional presence.
  • Your background: civil construction, with proven experience leading operations, teams and subcontractors in demanding project environments.

job.title: Chief Financial Officer
job.description:
PARTNER Executive is proud to be supporting an ASX-listed gold development company on the search for a Chief Financial Officer. With a flagship, large-scale asset in one of the world's premier gold producing regions, a landmark strategic funding agreement recently secured, and a strong balance sheet, our client is transitioning from development through to project execution and, ultimately, operations.

Reporting to the Managing Director, the CFO will act as a key strategic partner to the MD and Board, providing commercial and financial leadership across funding strategy, capital management, project development and operational readiness.

The Opportunity:

  • Lead the Company's funding strategy: engage directly with banks, investors and financial institutions as the business progresses toward development and construction.
  • A genuine seat at the table: partner with the Managing Director and Board on strategic decision-making at a pivotal stage of growth.
  • Broad commercial scope: critical insight across budgeting, forecasting, capital allocation and project economics, working closely with corporate and technical teams.
  • Build for scale: shape finance and IT capability, and strengthen reporting, governance and risk frameworks as the business grows.
  • Resources sector experience essential: exposure to both project development and operational environments, with hands-on industry experience (not solely advisory or banking). Gold and/or copper experience highly regarded.
  • Demonstrated involvement in debt funding processes will be key, with the ability to support or lead lender and investor engagement.
